column3: A Strange Menu
Hold it... What did you mean to say just now?
B-But... this music is just a den-
Guh!
What is it? Do you have anything against my creation?
Like I said, this music is a den-
Ah, so that's it. I see!
What are you convincing yourself of?!
You're just jealous, right?! After all, I'm the only one with all the talents!
I have too many objections.
Why do I have to listen to such a terrible denpa song?
You're speechless after hearing it, right?
In that case, could you not add in any unnecessary comments?
Well, I'm both intelligent and beautiful. I can understand your jealousy for the flawless me-
Flawless, are you seriously saying that?
I believe a person full of flaws can never understand.
I don't want to understand either!
Well, I'll praise you for playing the straight man part.
I think you did pretty well there.
I don't even have the energy to retort...
What? If you have something to say, speak up.
Grrr... Attacking me for being silent...
Yes? What? Come on? Hurry.
Come on, praise me, the genius with all of the talents. Hurry, hurry, hurry!
You're too noisy! What's with this speed-talking?!
Like I said! Envy is unsightly!
She's hopeless... It's useless to say anything more to her...
I'm just a piece of rock... An emotionless, useless piece of rock...
Also, you've been complaining non-stop now. It's really irritating!
It won't do if this is enough to trouble you～
T-There's more?
I'm not telling you. Besides, you'll know by then.
What's with that?!
It's obvious you just want to say it!
You'll be listening to the chorus of this godly song soon. Do look forward to it!
*sigh*... We're talking about Kirino here; she surely has something up her sleeve...
Then, if you don't have any complaints, tell me 3 good points about this godly song.
Either - way! I'll be taking the whole world with this!
What's with that?! What world are you talking about?!
You're noisy.
There is no world you can conquer with this song!
Soon you'll be hearing the chorus of this godly song. Look forward to it.
Just do whatever you want...
Then, if you don't have any complaints, tell me 3 good points of this godly song.
